Hello! I am an incoming PhD student in the Statistics and Data Science department at UPenn Wharton.

I am broadly excited about the mathematical foundations of machine learning. 
My research interests include diffusion models, mechanistic interpretability, and optimal transport. I have also recently become curious about
topological data analysis as a tool for interpretability. 

Before beginning my PhD, I completed my BS in Mathematics at the University of Chicago,
where I was fortunate to work with Prof. Lorenzo Orecchia on sampling algorithms utilizing optimal transport, and studying 
properties of diffusion models using evolution semigroups.

Outside of research, I enjoy playing board games (my current favorite is Blood on the Clocktower, a social deduction game),
attending the symphony orchestra, and SCUBA diving.

If we share any common interests, please feel free to get in touch!
